newsitem.title: spain: Albania under-21 team mulls asylum bid - player.
newsitem.headline: Albania under-21 team mulls asylum bid - player.

text.p: A member of Albania's under-21 soccer squad said on Wednesday he and his teammates wanted to stay in Spain after playing two matches here and would soon decide whether to seek asylum.
"It's true we want to stay here. But we still don't know what we will do. We will decide tonight or tomorrow morning," under-21 player Zeka Kresnic told Reuters.

Kresnic, who spoke while watching Albania's national team competing against Germany in Granada, said he and his teammates could no longer play soccer in their strife-torn homeland and hoped instead to sign with foreign clubs.
A pair of home matches for Albania's national team and two games for its under-21 squad were moved to Spain because of political unrest sweeping their Balkan nation.

The national team, which had World Cup European group qualifier matches in Granada against Ukraine and Germany, was drawn from Albanians playing for clubs outside their own country, mostly in Greece, Germany, Slovenia, Croatia, Romania and Malta.
But the under-21 squad was assembled from teams in the Albanian soccer league. The players and their coaches were scheduled to fly home to Albania sometime Thursday.
But some of the under-21 players were having second thoughts. "We would like to stay here in Spain." Kresnic said. "We cannot play in Albania. We hope to be signed by teams."

Eduard Dervishi, general secretary of the Albanian Soccer Federation, said he knew nothing about the players' plans but noted that "because there is no football being played in Albania it is probable they will want to play elsewhere."
When asked about Kresnic's comments, national team coach Haafizi Astrit declared: "It's none of my business."
A Spanish foreign ministry spokesman said the government had not received any asylum requests from Albanian players.
Asked about a news report that members of his team had contacted Spanish human rights groups, Kresnic said: "I hope it's true. I heard something about it."
Albania's under-21 team fared poorly in its Spanish matches, losing 0-4 to Germany on Tuesday and 0-3 against Ukraine last Saturday.
Albania's national team also suffered two defeats. It was beaten 2-3 by Germany on Wednesday and 0-1 by Ukraine last Saturday.
